# Final Project

This repository contains the proposal, data files, plot.ly graphs, index.html, about.html, ... for **p8105 Final Project**. 

## Data sources

Below describes instructions for how our data files were acquired. They were filtered from their original sources into working .csv files.

### 311 Rat Complaints (Jan 2020 - Nov 2026)

The data file `nyc_311_2020` contains 311 call data from the Department of Health and Mental Hygiene filtered for reports on Rodent Sightings, Rodent/Mice, Conditions Attracting Rodents, and Signs of Rodents that span between January 1st, 2020 to November 11th, 2026.

#### Instructions:

- Access NYC Open Data: https://data.cityofnewyork.us/Social-Services/311-Service-Requests-from-2020-to-Present/erm2-nwe9/about_data
- Select *311 Service Requests from 2020 to Present*
- Filter *Created Date* `is between` 2020 Jan 01 `AND` 2026 NOV 22
- Filter *Agency* to `DOHMH`
- Filter *Problem Detail (formerly descriptor)* to `Rodent Sightings`, `Rodent/Mice`, `Conditions Attracting Rodents`, and `Signs of Rodents`.
- Export data set
